cases.title: Initialize Financial Summary with Empty LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the Expense Tracker application with no stored transactions in local storage, the financial summary displays balance, income, and expenses all set to $0.00 in elements with data-testid 'balance', 'income', and 'expense' respectively.

cases.title: Add Valid Transaction and Update History
cases.description: Verify that entering a description and amount, then clicking the 'Add Transaction' button successfully adds the transaction to the list with data-testid 'transaction-list' and displays the correct description, amount, and date.

cases.title: Validation Error for Empty Description or Amount
cases.description: Verify that leaving the 'Description' or 'Amount' input field empty triggers an alert with the message 'Please enter valid description and amount.' and prevents the transaction from being added.

cases.title: Remove Transaction and Update Totals and LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the remove button next to a transaction entry removes it from the DOM, recalculates balance, income, and expense totals, and updates the 'transactions' key in local storage.

cases.title: Persist Transactions Across Page Reloads
cases.description: Verify that transactions added to the Expense Tracker persist across sessions by storing them in localStorage under the key 'transactions' and correctly reloading them upon page startup.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all essential requirements, and correctly target testable behaviors without any blockers.
All test cases are well-aligned with the requirements and properly test initialization, valid transaction creation, input validation, transaction deletion, and persistence via localStorage.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes initializing and displaying financial summary with balance, income, and expense set to $0.00 when localStorage is empty. Boundaries cover empty localStorage vs. non-empty. Normal path: loads with $0.00 defaults. Abnormal/ambiguous paths: corrupted storage formatting or invalid JSON structures. Selectors: 'balance', 'income', 'expense'. R-2, R-3, R-5, R-6, R-8: Testable behavior centers on adding transactions via 'description-input', 'amount-input', and 'add-transaction-button'. Boundaries: empty inputs, zero amounts, very long descriptions, positive values (income), negative values (expenses). Normal path: successful validation adds transaction to 'transaction-list', clears inputs, updates totals ('balance', 'income', 'expense'), and persists to localStorage under 'transactions'. Abnormal path: missing or invalid fields trigger alert 'Please enter valid description and amount.' and prevent addition. R-6, R-7: Testable behavior includes removing transactions via a remove button ('X'). Boundaries: deleting the single remaining transaction leaving an empty list and zeroed financials vs. deleting one of multiple transactions. Normal path: removes item from DOM and localStorage, recalculates and updates balance, income, and expense elements, and persists the updated 'transactions' key.
